anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

pass_a_gloss: For since he has never built, when he builds, then he first-builds; for another house before this he has not built. Yet even if this house which he builds is first, it has with its being first also a beginning, so that the beginning is taken upon the foundation, and the first it has because he first-builds this.
pass_b_english: For since he has never built, when he builds, then he builds for the first time. He has not built another house before this one. Yet even if this house he is building is first, it has, along with being first, a beginning as well — so that the beginning [is taken of] the foundation, while the first [it has because he is building] this [for the first time].
source_text: Ἐπεὶ γὰρ οὐδέποτε ᾠκ[οδό]μησεν, ὅτε οἰκοδομε[ῖ, τό]τε πρώτως οἰκοδομεῖ[· ἄλ]λην γὰρ πρὸ ταύτης οἰκία[ν ο]ὐκ ᾠκοδόμησεν. Ἔχει μέν[τ]οι, εἰ καὶ πρώτη ἐστὶν αὕ[τη], ἣν οἰκοδομεῖ οἰκίαν, μ[ετὰ] τοῦ π[ρ]ώτην αὐτὴν ε[ἶναι] κ[αὶ] ἀρχὴν {ἔχει}, ἵνα ἡ μὲν [ἀρχ]ὴ [ἐπὶ] τοῦ θεμελίου λαμβ[άνηται, τὸ] δὲ πρῶ[τ]ον ἔ[χει ὅτι ταύτη]ν πρώτως ο[ἰκοδομεῖ.]
